effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] If [Okuwamon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if this Digimon is attacking, you may switch the target of the attack to 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon.
[Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
